details.name: direct-run B2H2 duplicates original median128 endpoint

qualification: Conditional model comparison. The 256 mesh row tests the already selected quartet, not every possible composition at 256. A separately labeled 256 late-outflow row uses twice the original B2 end time if available, so combines mesh and endpoint-extension effects. Nominal compositions preserve prepared pulse energy and actual isotope endpoints. Construction, charge preparation, capsule additions, assembly response and receiver transport remain separate model layers; no confidence interval inferred from mesh or recipe spread.
